hypothesis: Runtime-observable structured constraint coverage, explicit-negative contradiction, neutral no-preference, provenance/invalidation, turn, and sparse-confidence features improve the audited metadata depth-3 GBDT without hidden or future information.

controls.matched_oof_control: audited metadata depth-3 GBDT with identical folds, training groups, Top-50 head, and frozen per-fold round counts
controls.backward_ablation: remove every constraint_runtime_v1 feature while preserving all other code, data, folds, and rounds

feature_semantics.positive: Coverage uses active positive ConversationState values only.
feature_semantics.negative: Contradiction uses active explicit negative values only.
feature_semantics.no_preference: No-preference is neutral context and is never scored as candidate-negative.
feature_semantics.override: Inactive/invalidated values are counted only as context and never used for candidate coverage.
feature_semantics.provenance: Explicit and simulator-answer active coverage are separate; profile/scenario/target fields are absent.
feature_semantics.confidence: Top-1 sparse margin and normalized sparse score entropy are computed from the current runtime retrieval result.

selection_prohibitions: no target, profile, scenario, future-turn, or holdout features
